svg.aria-label: A risk claim needs sample assumptions, candidate control, numerical model validity and frozen target evaluation; a single training score cannot replace any of them.
svg.title: Assumption chain for a generalisation report
svg.desc: A risk claim needs sample assumptions, candidate control, numerical model validity and frozen target evaluation; a single training score cannot replace any of them.

g.text: Sample: IID units, loss range and target P
Class: precontrolled or independently built candidates
Numerics: PSD, scale, solve and objective convention
Evaluation: frozen choice, paired metrics and shift limits
